alt: 學生學會老師的摺紙方法後，進一步做出更精巧的作品，老師驚喜地欣賞學生超越原先示範的成果。
scene_prompt: 青出於藍 means a student or younger generation surpasses the teacher. Modern origami workshop with an older adult teacher and a teenage student. Teacher holds the well-made SIMPLE paper crane he taught, while the student presents her own much more complex elegant paper phoenix with layered fanned tail and finely folded wings, developed beyond the original lesson. Both use the SAME natural sky-blue paper to connect the lesson and the student's advancement. Teacher is visibly delighted and impressed, gesturing toward the student's superior intricate workmanship with pride; student modestly pleased, not boastful or ridiculing teacher. Fold practice papers and a simple visual-only crane diagram lie on the table. No text, no trophies, no named characters, phoenix is an original folded-paper craft not a franchise creature.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
